name: Devil's Smile
description: A notorious ship, renamed Devil's Chains after Angrath's mutiny.

timeline.summary: Trapped by Ixalan's Binding, Angrath joins Captain Radcliff's crew, then leads a nearly bloodless mutiny and renames the ship Devil's Chains.
timeline.quote: the minotaur led a quick and almost bloodless mutiny that left Radcliff hanging by a gaff hook strapped to the bowsprit.

citation.text: "Angrath", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: He became captain and renamed the ship Devil's Chains.
relations.quote: Now a Captain, Angrath changed the ship's name to Devil's Chains
